name: @sos-2/runtimes
description: SOS 2.0 Runtimes: the runtime contract — typed runtime descriptors (kind, version, capabilities, constraints) plus a RuntimeHost that executes DECLARED operations against declared runtimes. EXECUTION IS AUTHORITY CHECKED: every execution request carries a grant reference validated through @sos-2/authority grant evaluation before running (expired/revoked/missing -> EXECUTION_DENIED with a structured reason). Every execution emits a typed, evidence-shaped observation record with truthful availability linked to the SystemState revision it observed (OBSERVES/VERIFIES trace links); runtime observations NEVER mutate System State directly — they are input to reconciliation. Platform behavior is Context/Adapter data: runtime/platform specifics live in typed context dimensions consumed from @sos-2/context, never as semantic branches in domain logic (Work Order W12; spec/architecture.md sections 17-18, R18, R21).
